d:
Bihar ke hajipur (vaishali) se ek behad sanasnikhej aur dil dahla dene vali vardat samne aaee hai. yahan rat ke andhere men jamini vivad ko lekar 20 ki sankhya men pahunche bekhauph apradhiyon ne karib 10 raund tabartor phayring kar pure ilake men dahshat phaila di.
Is khuni sangharsh aur andhadhundh golibari men ek mahila samet do log ganbhir rup se jakhmi ho gae hain. vardat ko anjam dene ke bad sabhi hamlavar mauke se pharar ho gae. ghatna ki suchna milte hi sthaniy thana pulis dal-bal ke sath mauke par pahunchi aur jakhmiyon ko ilaj ke lie turant aspatal pahunchaya.
